description: Duplicate patient IDs
action: Merge duplicate MRNs before attribution; duplicates double-count denominators.

description: Duplicate encounter IDs
action: Deduplicate encounters; duplicates inflate utilization and readmissions.

description: Same patient, same vital sign, same timestamp recorded more than once
action: Keep one value per timestamp so 'most recent reading' logic is deterministic.

description: Encounters whose patient does not exist
action: Route to registration/HIM to resolve orphaned visits.

description: Observations linked to a non-existent encounter
action: Labs without a visit cannot be attributed to a provider or date of service.

description: Conditions linked to a non-existent encounter
action: Diagnoses without a source visit weaken denominator evidence.

description: Encounters with no payer on file
action: Payer is needed to assign the measure to the right program (Medicare Stars, Medi-Cal, commercial).

description: Encounter ends before it starts
action: Fix timestamps; negative length of stay breaks readmission windows.

description: Clinical encounter starts after the patient's date of death
action: Post-mortem clinical activity indicates a wrong patient match or a death-date error.

description: Administrative 'Death Certification' encounter after date of death
action: Expected: paperwork filed 1-14 days after death. Exclude from utilization counts; no correction needed.

description: Encounter starts before the patient's birth date
action: Pre-birth activity indicates a mis-keyed birth date (affects age-based eligibility).

description: Condition resolved before it began
action: Correct problem-list dates; drives whether a diagnosis is 'active'.

description: Records dated after the extract date
action: Future-dated results usually mean a data-entry or interface time-zone error.

description: Inpatient stays longer than 60 days
action: Review outliers; long stays can be real but often reflect a missing discharge.

description: Systolic BP outside 50-300 mmHg
action: Exclude from CBP numerator and send back to the clinic for correction.

description: Diastolic BP outside 20-200 mmHg
action: Exclude from CBP numerator and send back to the clinic for correction.

description: Diastolic reading >= systolic reading at the same visit
action: Likely transposed values; flag for chart review.

description: HbA1c outside the 4-18 % assay reportable range
action: Values below 4% are not reportable by standard assays; in production this pattern usually means an interface or mapping error. Excluded from GSD; send to lab interface team.

description: HbA1c recorded in a unit other than %
action: Mixed units (e.g. mmol/mol) must be converted before applying the 8% / 9% thresholds.

description: Numeric lab or vital that will not parse as a number
action: Text in numeric result fields cannot be counted toward a measure.

description: BMI outside 10-100
action: Check height/weight entry.

description: Patient missing race or ethnicity
action: Needed for health-equity stratification (CMS and NCQA now require it).

description: Patient missing gender or birth date
action: Age and sex define eligibility for nearly every measure.

description: Patient missing ZIP code
action: ZIP supports geographic outreach and SDOH linkage.

description: Encounter missing provider
action: Provider is needed for attribution and provider-level scorecards.
